career_ladder.note: Design Trainees (DT) and Management Trainees (MT) in Hindustan Aeronautics Limited undergo 52 weeks of structured training and are absorbed as Engineers in Executive Grade-II. Promotion through executive management grades is governed by HAL Merit-cum-Seniority Promotion Policy, annual performance appraisal ratings, and minimum residency periods.

HAL Advt. No. HAL/CHRC-TM/RECT-02/2026 Para 10.3 (Absorption Scale)

exam_scheme.note: Selection process comprises an All-India Online Computer Based Selection Test and Personal Interview at Bengaluru. Final merit is drawn by assigning 85% weightage to the Online Selection Test and 15% weightage to the Personal Interview. Candidates must secure at least 50% marks in both stages (with relaxation for reserved categories).

financial_package.note: During 52 weeks of training, Trainees receive a stipend based on entry basic pay of ₹50,000, Variable Dearness Allowance, and Canteen Allowance with bachelor accommodation. On absorption as Engineer in Grade-II (scale ₹50,000–₹1,60,000), officers receive full benefits under cafeteria approach (up to 35%), 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, and HRA.
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹50,000 with 58% Variable DA (₹29,000), Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria System up to 35% of Basic Pay (₹17,500), House Rent Allowance (9% to 27% = ₹4,500 to ₹13,500 depending on posting division), less Provident Fund (12% of Basic+DA = ₹9,480) and statutory deductions. Annual CTC ranges from ₹15 to ₹18 Lakhs.

Bachelor accommodation and subsidized canteen allowance during training period
